entries.title: First Feudal

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: First Feudal left Early Access on April 8, 2021 and is documented on Steam and GOG as a Windows medieval colony/city-building strategy game with Workshop support and online co-op on Steam. No sourced console, Mac, Linux, or mobile release was found in this pass, so Windows PC is the complete archive route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows PC release on Steam or GOG. Use Steam if Workshop scenarios or online co-op coverage are part of the archive run.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with Steam Workshop support, Steam co-op features, and a DRM-free GOG alternative.
all_releases.reason: primary: only sourced release platform and best archive route.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No alternate platform or edition split was found.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or definitive edition split was found; use the latest patched PC build.
